# Round 5, R2 (docs/gpu-experiments/05-final/02-local-gpu-split.md): the finals interleaved, A the stack
# (--final) and B the stack with POLL_SLEEP=8, at 30, 31 and 32 iterations (A30 B30 A31 B31 A32 B32), each
# with the compare (green by R1's rules) and the table; then A29 and B29 without the event timing, the
# FWD_PASS clock. DECIDE A1: POLL_SLEEP=8 into the default if B's medians are not above A's on either
# clock; the round's number is the default's three with its FWD_PASS.
--layers 27 --head --iters 30 --final compare table continue    # A30
--layers 27 --head --iters 30 --final --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=8 compare table continue    # B30
--layers 27 --head --iters 31 --final compare table continue    # A31
--layers 27 --head --iters 31 --final --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=8 compare table continue    # B31
--layers 27 --head --iters 32 --final compare table continue    # A32
--layers 27 --head --iters 32 --final --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=8 compare table continue    # B32
--layers 27 --head --iters 29 --final --no-event-timing table continue    # A29: FWD_PASS
--layers 27 --head --iters 29 --final --no-event-timing --runtime-flags=-DMPK_POLL_SLEEP=8 table continue    # B29: FWD_PASS
